description:
The drop-bar Darien is made for self-supported exploration, where endurance and capability matter most. Its geometry offers long-distance comfort and confidence on rough, unpredictable terrain. With clearance for 29” x 2.6” tires and compatibility with suspension or rigid forks, it’s ready for loaded bikepacking trips, remote dirt roads, and the wild trails in between. Built to go far, and then farther.

Built to withstand the harshest conditions, the Scarab Darien is built by hand in our shop in Colombia ensuring the highest quality construction possible. With a robust design and using top of the line steels. The frame offers exceptional strength-to-weight ratio, impact resistance, and longevity, making them ideal for any adventure. Our precise tubing selections, tailored to each rider are intended to offer comfort on long days in the saddle.

"Inspired by the untamed spirit of the Darién Gap, this bike is built for those who see obstacles as part of the adventure. The Darién is a pure expression of rugged determination - agile, resilient, and ready to take you beyond the beaten path. It’s a machine for those who embrace the unknown, turning every ride into an exploration of what’s possible."
